title: Thank you:
headline: Mackinnon thanks two donors from inside the hospital their giving helps.
story: A personal video message, not a public post. Mackinnon stands at Clínica Noel in Medellín and thanks Narendra and Amishi by name: for every call, for their whole heart, for the trust.
One take, cut clean. It should feel like she is talking to them, not to an audience. Warm and simple. Captions on, almost no branding.
do: Use the single take, start to finish.
Keep captions on for the whole message.
Caption Clínica Noel with the accent.
Out after “Thanks so much. Bye.” at 00:46.5.
dont: No name super, no title, no logo at the start.
No B-roll. It is a personal message.
No crop: the clip is already vertical.

rows.frame_alt: Mackinnon, vertical close shot, black Watsi T-shirt and backpack, Clínica Noel wall behind
rows.visual: Vertical, already framed. Start on frame 1 of the clip: she is already smiling at the lens. No crop.
rows.motion: Captions from the first word. Caption “Clínica Noel” with the accent. No name super: Narendra and Amishi know her.

voice.quote: Hola, Narendra and Amishi, I'm here in Colombia at Clínica Noel.

rows.frame_alt: Mackinnon talking, Fundación Clínica Noel wall behind
rows.visual: Same take. No cuts. It is one single take and should feel like a phone call.

voice.quote: This is one of our medical partners and I'm having just the greatest day meeting all the patients we've helped and it really sticks with me that this wouldn't be possible without everything you do.

rows.motion: Captions only. “Watsi” with a capital W.

voice.quote: So I want to thank you really every time I call, every time I talk to you, you just give your whole heart to Watsi and this work and I'm here seeing the transformation that really has on people's lives.
So thank you for all the trust you put in us and everything you do that unlocks more of this in the world.

rows.visual: Same take. Out at 00:46.5, after “Thanks so much. Bye.” An out-point at 00:45 would cut “Thanks so much” in half.

voice.quote: I can't wait to maybe be at a hospital with you someday. It would be phenomenal. So see you soon. Thanks so much. Bye.

tech: Stored as 3840×2160 with a rotation flag: it plays vertical, 2160×3840. 23.976 fps, 2-ch audio recorded into the camera.
1080×1920 at 23.976 fps. Check that Premiere reads the rotation. If it shows sideways, rotate 90° once.
2 channels in the camera file. Pick the live channel on the waveform and map it to both sides. (Not measured: the Drive download limit stopped the audio check.)
Lato Bold, white, soft shadow, large. Pop word by word. No highlight box, no shading block. One line at a time. Always on screen, also in pauses. Keep the bottom 20% clear for app buttons.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, about 16 Mbps. One file.
checklist: Read every caption against the audio.
Narendra and Amishi are spelled exactly like this.
Clínica Noel has the accent on the í.
Watsi has a capital W only. watsi.org is lowercase.
The message ends after “Bye.”, not in the middle of “Thanks so much”.
No music and no extra branding.
client_note: Why this matters: this goes straight to two loyal donors. It must feel personal and correct. One typo in their names ruins it.
